主要内容: IMPERIAL CAPITAL BANCORP, INC. disclosed that due to its inability to file reports compliant with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, it intends to file monthly operating reports under Form 8-K with the Office of the United States Trustee. On January 20, 2012, and February 21, 2012, the company filed unaudited reports for December 2011 and January 2012 with the OUST, as required by the OUST Guidelines. These reports are limited in scope, shorter in time period, and prepared solely for compliance with bankruptcy court and OUST guidelines, and do not comply with the Exchange Act. The financial information is preliminary and unaudited, and may exclude items required by GAAP. The company cautioned readers not to place undue reliance on the reports, which may be subject to revision and are not indicative of future results. Previously, the company and Holdco Advisors L.P. filed a proposed plan of reorganization with the Bank. If confirmed, creditors may not be paid in full based on available assets.
